columns.name: is_sso_user
columns.comment: Auth: Set this column to true when the account comes from SSO. These accounts can have duplicate emails.

columns.name: email
columns.comment: Auth: Email is a generated column that references the optional email property in the identity_data

columns.name: not_after
columns.comment: Auth: Not after is a nullable column that contains a timestamp after which the session should be regarded as expired.

columns.name: refresh_token_hmac_key
columns.comment: Holds a HMAC-SHA256 key used to sign refresh tokens for this session.

columns.name: refresh_token_counter
columns.comment: Holds the ID (counter) of the last issued refresh token.

columns.name: last_webauthn_challenge_data
columns.comment: Stores the latest WebAuthn challenge data including attestation/assertion for customer verification

columns.name: resource_id
columns.comment: Auth: Uniquely identifies a SSO provider according to a user-chosen resource ID (case insensitive), useful in infrastructure as code.

columns.name: issuer
columns.check: issuer IS NULL OR char_length(issuer) >= 1 AND char_length(issuer) <= 2048

columns.name: owner
columns.comment: Field is deprecated, use owner_id instead

columns.name: lifecycle_configuration
columns.check:
lifecycle_configuration IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(lifecycle_configuration) = 'object'::text AND lifecycle_configuration ? 'rules'::text AND
CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text) = 'array'::text THEN jsonb_array_length(lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text) >= 1 AND jsonb_array_length(lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text) <= 1000
    ELSE false
END

columns.name: owner
columns.comment: Field is deprecated, use owner_id instead

columns.name: card_price
columns.check: card_price >= 0.01 AND card_price <= 10.00 AND card_price = round(card_price, 2)

columns.name: prize_share
columns.comment: Legacy compatibility metadata only. ASIX live prize starting percentage is selected by funded player count in qcard_process_action.

columns.name: platform_share
columns.comment: Legacy compatibility metadata only. ASIX live reserve is calculated as the unallocated remainder after the 97 percent four-cut target.

columns.name: growth_steps
columns.comment: Legacy compatibility metadata only. Stores the five-player reference targets; actual per-deal cumulative targets are in qcard_game_state.state.growth_weights.

columns.name: state
columns.default_value: jsonb_build_object('phase', 'waiting', 'dealer_seat', 1, 'current_turn_user_id', NULL::unknown, 'trump_suit', NULL::unknown, 'top_card', NULL::unknown, 'last_cutter_user_id', NULL::unknown, 'pot_tetri', 0, 'side_tetri', 0, 'played_cards', '[]'::jsonb, 'players', '[]'::jsonb, 'pending_raise_tetri', 0, 'raise_owner_user_id', NULL::unknown, 'raise_queue', '[]'::jsonb, 'successful_cuts', 0, 'pot_start_tetri', 0, 'growth_budget_tetri', 0, 'growth_added_tetri', 0, 'growth_weights', jsonb_build_array(12.00, 15.45, 24.75, 22.13), 'growth_reserve_tetri', 0, 'max_table_pool_tetri', 0, 'deck_remaining', 36, 'current_bet_tetri', 0, 'betting_contributions', '{}'::jsonb, 'round_contributions', '{}'::jsonb)

columns.name: fee_per_player_tetri
columns.comment: Deprecated legacy field; always zero. V147 uses commission_rate_bps instead.

columns.name: commission_rate_bps
columns.comment: ASIX V147 commission rate in basis points; 500 = 5% of the whole deal Entry Fee.

columns.name: commission_rate_bps
columns.check: commission_rate_bps IS NULL OR commission_rate_bps >= 0 AND commission_rate_bps <= 10000

columns.name: settled_at
columns.comment: When the pending V147 commission was credited after successful deal completion.

columns.name: cancelled_at
columns.comment: When pending V147 commission was voided because the deal was cancelled/refunded.
